name: DolocCoop - Steam Multiplayer
author: sma1lboy
description: Steam-based co-op multiplayer for Doloc Town. Host a lobby (F9), invite friends (F10), and farm together. Requires BepInEx. Alpha - back up your saves.

localized_description.schinese: 基于 Steam 的多人联机模组。F9 创建大厅,F10 邀请好友,一起经营小镇。需要 BepInEx 前置。开发中版本,请务必备份存档。
localized_description.tchinese: 基於 Steam 的多人聯機模組。F9 建立大廳,F10 邀請好友,一起經營小鎮。需要 BepInEx 前置。開發中版本,請務必備份存檔。
